use_scalar_bias_function: use scalar_bias to prepend a learnable scalar vector to a PyTorch tensor along a specified dimension
apply_scalar_bias_autograd: apply the ScalarBias autograd function to add a bias-initialized dimension to input tensors for self-attention
review_scalar_bias_forward: review the ScalarBias forward pass that expands tensor size along a dimension and fills with bias_init value
test_scalar_bias_backward: test the ScalarBias backward pass that extracts gradients from the expanded dimension using narrow
refactor_scalar_bias_for_attention: refactor the scalar_bias function to customize the default bias_init value for self-attention mechanisms
